# `query_workspace_symbol_relationships`

[Back to the MCP API router](../../mcp-api.md)

Query bounded definitions, inheritance, references, and callers for one revision-bound workspace symbol. Reference results come from the language-owned workspace index, not an MCP text scan.

### Stable failures

Workspace tools return structured tool errors with a stable code and retry guidance. They never expose physical workspace paths or Workbench log references.
